paragraphs: Neurocrine Biosciences is a neuroscience-focused, biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing, and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine, and immunological disorders.

Our portfolio of products includes U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia (TD), chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency (CAH), and endometriosis and uterine fibroids in collaboration with AbbVie Inc. In addition, we have a diversified portfolio of multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase development across our core therapeutic areas and an expanding early-phase pipeline that includes a range of modalities including small molecules, peptides, proteins, antibodies, conjugates, and gene therapies.

We launched INGREZZA® (valbenazine) in the U.S. as the first FDA-approved drug for the treatment of TD in May 2017 and for the treatment of chorea associated with Huntington's disease in August 2023 and launched CRENESSITY® (crinecerfont) in the U.S. as a first-in-class FDA-approved treatment of CAH in December 2024.

We estimate that TD affects approximately 800,000 people in the U.S., that approximately 90% of the 40,000 people in the U.S. affected by Huntington's disease will develop chorea, and that CAH affects at least 20,000 people in the U.S. Key elements of our commercial strategy include maximizing the opportunities in INGREZZA and CRENESSITY through consistent and effective commercial execution, continued development of valbenazine as the best-in-class treatment for new patient populations, and to lead the evolving understanding of vesicular monoamine transporter 2 (VMAT2) biology and its role in disease. INGREZZA net product sales were $2.51 billion for 2025, $2.31 billion for 2024, and $1.84 billion for 2023 and accounted for a significant portion of our total net product sales during each of these years. CRENESSITY net product sales were $301.2 million for 2025 during its first full-year of launch.

(1) INGREZZA is marketed as DYSVAL® (valbenazine) in Japan and REMLEAS® (valbenazine) in other select Asian markets, where Tanabe Pharma Corporation (formerly Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma Corporation) retains commercialization rights.
(2) AbbVie retains global commercialization rights to elagolix.

We sell INGREZZA exclusively in the U.S. through a limited specialty network. Our customers include select specialty pharmacy providers, wholesale distributors, and specialty distributors. This focused distribution model allows us to closely manage product supply and support services. In addition, we sell CRENESSITY in the U.S. through a single specialty pharmacy provider, reflecting the product's rare disease focus and the need for high-touch distribution. We rely on third-party logistics providers for packaging, warehousing, and shipment of our products, leveraging their expertise to ensure timely delivery and broad patient access.

Our commercial reach is powered by a specialized sales force of approximately 600 professionals across the U.S. focused on neurology, psychiatry, long-term care, and rare diseases. In October 2025, we announced the planned expansion of the INGREZZA and CRENESSITY sales teams to maximize our commercial momentum. We expect this expansion, which we anticipate completing by the end of the first quarter of 2026, will boost our reach and frequency with prescribers, accelerating INGREZZA's penetration in both community and institutional settings and supporting the growth trajectory of CRENESSITY in the endocrinology and rare disease community. Importantly, a larger sales force and enhanced infrastructure also position us for potential upcoming product launches from our diversified pipeline, which includes late-stage candidates in major depressive disorder (osavampator) and schizophrenia (direclidine). We believe these investments in commercial capabilities will translate into sustained revenue growth and shareholder value, as we drive current product performance and prepare to bring new therapies to market.

We currently rely on, and intend to continue to rely on, third-party manufacturers for the production of INGREZZA, CRENESSITY, and our product candidates. Raw materials, active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), and other supplies required for the production of INGREZZA, CRENESSITY, and our product candidates are sourced from various third-party manufacturers and suppliers in quantities adequate to meet our needs. We believe that continuing adequate supply of such raw materials and API is assured through long-term commercial supply and manufacturing agreements with multiple manufacturers and a continued focus on the expansion and diversification of our third-party manufacturing relationships.

We believe our outsourced manufacturing strategy enables us to direct our financial resources to maximize our commercial opportunities with INGREZZA and CRENESSITY, invest in our internal research and development programs, and expand our clinical pipeline through business development opportunities.

Our third-party manufacturers, suppliers, and service providers may be subject to routine current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) inspections by the FDA or comparable agencies in other jurisdictions. We depend on our third-party partners and our quality system oversight of them for continued compliance with cGMP requirements and applicable foreign standards.

Our research and development pipeline is robust and diversified across neurology, psychiatry, endocrinology, and immunology. This pipeline is fueled by core expertise in key areas of receptor biology developed over three decades. We are leveraging validated biological pathways and novel modalities to advance what we believe are potential first-in-class or best-in-class treatment candidates for patients with serious and under-addressed conditions. Our strategy is to maintain a balanced portfolio by stage of development and across our therapeutic areas of interest – targeting prevalent central nervous system (CNS) disorders such as depression, bipolar, and schizophrenia on one hand, and rare/orphan diseases such as CAH on the other – thereby positioning Neurocrine Biosciences to deliver a steady cadence of innovative medicines for years to come. By harnessing both novel validated mechanisms and our proprietary platforms, we aim to launch, on average, approximately one new medicine every two years, driving long-term value for patients and shareholders.

•Total net product sales for 2025 increased $503.3 million, or 21.6%, to $2.83 billion, reflecting increased net product sales of CRENESSITY, which was launched in the U.S. as a first-in-class FDA-approved treatment of CAH in December 2024, and INGREZZA, driven by record total prescriptions on strong patient demand, partially offset by a lower net price due to new market access investments to support long-term growth.

•In October 2025, we announced the planned expansion of the INGREZZA and CRENESSITY sales teams to maximize our commercial momentum. The expansion is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 2026.
•Appointed Sanjay Keswani, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and member of our executive management team, effective June 2, 2025.

•In February 2025, our Board of Directors authorized a new share repurchase program (the 2025 Repurchase Program) under which we may repurchase up to $500.0 million of our common stock, subject to market conditions. The 2025 Repurchase Program is in addition to the $300.0 million accelerated repurchase program (the 2024 Repurchase Program) that was announced in October 2024 and completed in February 2025. During 2025, we repurchased 1.5 million shares on the open market under the 2025 Repurchase Program and received an additional 0.3 million shares upon settlement of the 2024 Repurchase Program in February 2025.

•In January 2025, we received Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) notification that INGREZZA qualifies for the small biotech exception under the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program, which provides exemption from selection until 2027 for initial price applicability in 2029. In addition, we expanded formulary access for INGREZZA, significantly improving coverage to include approximately 70% of TD and Huntington's disease Medicare beneficiaries to support long-term growth.
•Announced the initiation of a Phase 2 clinical study of investigational compound NBI-1065890 in adults with TD. NBI-1065890 is a next-generation, selective inhibitor of VMAT2.

•Initiated a comprehensive Phase 3 clinical program for direclidine (NBI-1117568) in schizophrenia, including studies evaluating efficacy in acutely psychotic hospitalized patients and long-term safety. In addition, we initiated a Phase 2 study evaluating direclidine in bipolar mania in the fourth quarter of 2025.

•Initiated a comprehensive Phase 3 clinical program for osavampator (NBI-1065845) in major depressive disorder (MDD), including three acute randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled studies, a randomized‑withdrawal maintenance‑of‑effect study, and a long‑term open‑label safety extension.

•Initiated a Phase 1 clinical study for NBIP-01435, an investigational, long-acting corticotropin-releasing factor type 1 (CRF-1) receptor antagonist administered as a subcutaneous injection for the potential treatment of CAH.

paragraphs: Neurocrine Biosciences 是一家以神經科學為重點的生物製藥公司，其簡單的目標為：為有重大需求的患者緩解痛苦。我們致力於發現、開發及商業化改變生命的治療方案，用以治療未被充分照顧的神經系統、精神科、內分泌及免疫系統疾病患者。

我們的產品組合包括美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准的治療遲發性運動障礙（TD）、亨丁頓氏症相關的舞蹈症、因 21-氫化酶缺乏所導致的典型先天性腎上腺增生症（CAH）以及子宮內膜異位症及子宮肌瘤的治療方案，並與 AbbVie Inc. 合作。此外，我們擁有涵蓋核心治療領域的多種化合物，處於中後期開發階段的多元化產品組合，以及正在擴展中的早期開發管道，包含小分子、肽、蛋白質、抗體、結合物及基因治療等多種形式。
我們於 2017 年 5 月在美國推出 INGREZZA®（valbenazine），作為美國首個核准用於治療 TD 的藥物，並於 2023 年 8 月推出用於治療亨丁頓氏症相關舞蹈症的藥物，於 2024 年 12 月在美國推出 CRENESSITY®（crinecerfont），作為美國首個核准用於治療 CAH 的藥物。

我們估計 TD 會影響美國約 800,000 人，約 90% 的美國 40,000 名受亨丁頓氏症影響的患者會發展出 chorea，且 CAH 會影響美國至少 20,000 人。我們商業策略的關鍵要素包括透過持續且有效的商業執行，最大化 INGREZZA 和 CRENESSITY 的商機，持續發展 valbenazine 作為新患者羣體的最佳治療方案，並領導對囊泡單胺運輸體 2（VMAT2）生物學及其在疾病中角色的不斷進步理解。INGREZZA 的淨產品銷售額為 2025 年 2.51 十億美元，2024 年 2.31 十億美元，2023 年 1.84 十億美元，並在這些年份中佔我們總淨產品銷售額的顯著部分。CRENESSITY 的淨產品銷售額為 2025 年 301.2 百萬美元，為其首次完整財年發售的銷售額。
遲發性運動障礙 美國、日本、部分亞洲市場（1） 亨丁頓氏症相關的舞蹈症
(1) INGREZZA 在日本以 DYSVAL®（valbenazine）銷售，在其他部分亞洲市場以 REMLEAS®（valbenazine）銷售，其中 Tanabe Pharma Corporation（原為 Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma Corporation）保留商業化權限。
(2) AbbVie 保留 elagolix 的全球商業化權限。

本公司獨家於美國透過有限的專門藥品經銷網路銷售 INGREZZA。我們的客戶包括選擇性的專門藥房供應商、 wholesalers 及專門經銷商。此聚焦的經銷模式使我們能密切管理產品供應及支援服務。此外，我們透過單一專門藥房供應商於美國銷售 CRENESSITY，反映該產品針對罕見疾病的重點，以及需要高接觸度的經銷需求。我們依賴第三方物流供應商進行產品的包裝、倉儲及運送，利用其專業知識以確保及時交貨與廣泛的患者接觸。

我們的商業版圖由約 600 名專門銷售人員支撐，這些銷售人員於美國專注於神經學、精神醫學、長期照護及罕見疾病領域。2025 年 10 月，我們宣佈計畫擴充 INGREZZA 及 CRENESSITY 的銷售團隊，以最大化我們的商業動能。我們預期此擴充，我們預計於 2026 年第一季末完成，將提升我們與處方醫師的接觸範圍與頻率，加速 INGREZZA 在社區及機構環境中的滲透，並支持 CRENESSITY 在內分泌學及罕見疾病領域的成長軌跡。重要的是，較大的銷售團隊與強化基礎設施也使我們能應對未來可能的產品發佈，這些產品來自我們多樣化的產品管道，包括晚期候選藥物於重度抑鬱症（osavampator）及精神分裂症（direclidine）。我們相信這些對商業能力的投資將轉化為持續的營收成長與股東價值，因我們推動現有產品表現並準備推出新療法。

我們目前依賴，並計畫持續依賴第三方製造商來生產 INGREZZA、CRENESSITY 及我們的產品候選藥物。生產 INGREZZA、CRENESSITY 及我們的產品候選藥物所需的原料、活性藥物成分（API）及其他供應品，來自多個第三方製造商及供應商，數量足以滿足我們的需求。我們相信透過與多個製造商的長期商業供應及製造契約，以及持續擴展與多元化我們的第三方製造商關係，將確保這些原料及 API 的充足供應。
我們相信我們的委外製造策略使我們能將財務資源用於最大化 INGREZZA 及 CRENESSITY 的商業機會，投資於我們的內部研究與開發計畫，並透過商業發展機會擴展我們的臨牀產品管道。
我們的第三方製造商、供應商及服務提供者可能接受美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）或其它司法管轄區的同等機構的定期良好製造規範（cGMP）檢查。我們依賴第三方夥伴及我們的品質系統監督，以確保持續符合 cGMP 要求及適用的國際標準。

我們的研究與開發產品管道在神經學、精神醫學、內分泌學及免疫學領域均強而多元。此產品管道由過去三十年在關鍵受體生物學領域的核心專業知識所支撐。我們正利用已驗證的生物途徑及創新治療模式，推進我們認為可能為首創或最佳治療選擇的候選藥物，以治療嚴重且未被充分處理的疾病。我們的策略是透過產品開發階段及我們關注的治療領域來維持平衡的產品組合 – 一方面針對常見的中樞神經系統（CNS）疾病如抑鬱症、雙極性疾患及精神分裂症，另一方面則針對罕見/遺傳疾病如 CAH – 這使 Neurocrine Biosciences 能夠持續推出創新藥物，為患者及股東創造長期價值。透過結合創新已驗證的機制與我們的專利平台，我們目標是平均每兩年推出約一種新藥，推動長期的患者與股東價值。

Neurocrine Biosciences 為一專注於神經科學領域之生物製藥公司，其簡單宗旨為減輕有重大需求之患者之痛苦。本公司致力於發現、開發與商業化對患有未被充分治療之神經系統、精神科、內分泌及免疫系統疾病之患者具有改變生命之治療方案。

本公司產品組合包含美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准之治療遲發性運動障礙（TD）、亨丁頓氏症相關舞蹈症、因 21-氫化酶缺乏所致之典型先天性腎上腺增生症（CAH）及子宮內膜異位症與子宮肌瘤之治療方案，並與 AbbVie Inc.（AbbVie）合作。此外，本公司擁有涵蓋核心治療領域之多種化合物於中後期開發階段之多元化產品組合，並有擴展中的早期開發管道，包含小分子、肽、蛋白質、單克隆抗體、結合物及基因治療等多種模式。
本公司於 2017 年 5 月在美國推出 INGREZZA®（valbenazine），為美國首個核准用於治療 TD 之藥物，並於 2023 年 8 月核准用於治療亨丁頓氏症相關舞蹈症，於 2024 年 12 月在美國推出 CRENESSITY®（crinecerfont），為美國首個核准用於治療 CAH 之創新類藥物。

我們估計 TD 影響美國約 800,000 人，約 90% 的美國 40,000 人受亨丁頓氏症影響者將發展成 chorea，且 CAH 影響美國至少 20,000 人。我們商業策略的關鍵要素包括透過一致且有效的商業執行，最大化 INGREZZA 和 CRENESSITY 的機會，持續發展 valbenazine 為新患者族羣的最佳治療方案，並領導對囊泡單胺轉運體 2（VMAT2）生物學及其在疾病中角色的進步理解。INGREZZA 的淨產品銷售額為 2025 年 2.51 十億美元，2024 年 2.31 十億美元，2023 年 1.84 十億美元，並在這些年份中佔我們總淨產品銷售額的顯著部分。CRENESSITY 的淨產品銷售額為 2025 年 301.2 百萬美元，為其首次完整財年發售。
•2025 年總淨產品銷售額增加 503.3 百萬美元，或 21.6%，至 2.83 十億美元，反映 CRENESSITY 的淨產品銷售額增加，該產品於 2024 年 12 月在美國作為首個獲 FDA 批准的 CAH 治療方案發售，以及 INGREZZA 的銷售額增加，因總處方數創下紀錄且患者需求強勁，部分抵銷因新市場准入投資導致的淨價格下降。
•2025 年 10 月，本公司宣佈計畫擴編 INGREZZA 與 CRENESSITY 之銷售團隊，以最大化商業動能。擴編預計於 2026 年第一季末完成。
•2025 年 6 月 2 日起，任命 Sanjay Keswani, M.D. 為首席醫療官（CMO）及本公司高階管理團隊成員。

•民國114年1月，本公司收到美國醫療保險與醫療援助署（Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, CMS）的通知，指出INGREZZA符合 Medicare 藥品價格談判計畫中的小型生物科技公司例外條款，此計畫提供至2027年免於選取的豁免，並於2029年初始價格適用時生效。此外，本公司擴大INGREZZA的給付範圍，大幅提高覆蓋率，約包含70%的TD及亨丁頓氏症候羣的醫療保險受益人，以支持長期成長。
•宣佈啟動針對成人TD的第二期臨牀研究，研究的試驗性化合物為NBI-1065890。NBI-1065890為新一代選擇性VMAT2抑制劑。
•啟動針對精神分裂症的direclidine（NBI-1117568）全面性第三期臨牀計畫，包含評估急性癲癇住院患者療效的研究及長期安全性研究。此外，本公司於2025年第四季啟動針對雙極躁鬱症躁狂狀態的direclidine第二期研究。
•啟動針對重度憂鬱症（MDD）的osavampator（NBI-1065845）全面性第三期臨牀計畫，包含三項急性隨機雙盲安慰劑對照研究、隨機撤藥維持療效研究及長期開放標籤安全性延長研究。
•啟動針對CAH的NBIP-01435臨牀一期研究，NBIP-01435為一種試驗性長效皮下注射的皮質醇釋放因子類型1（CRF-1）受體拮抗劑。

paragraphs: 下列資訊說明了可能導致本公司實際結果與本年度10-K申報書中所載之預測性陳述，以及本公司未來可能做出之預測性陳述有重大差異的風險因素。若下列任何風險發生，將可能對本公司業務、營運成果、前景或財務狀況造成影響。此外，尚有其他未被本公司知悉或目前認為不重要之風險，也可能影響本公司業務運作。
本公司面臨與業務相關之風險與不確定性，許多風險超出了本公司控制範圍。特別是，與本公司業務相關之風險包括：
•本公司可能無法持續成功商業化INGREZZA或任何未來獲批准之產品候選藥物。
•本公司可能無法成功發行並商業化CRENESSITY。
•若醫師與患者無法持續接受INGREZZA或無法接受CRENESSITY，或本公司之銷售與市場推廣努力未能有效執行，本公司可能無法產生足夠之營業收入。
•本公司面臨激烈競爭，若本公司無法有效競爭，則本公司產品之需求可能減少。
